description:
The 2nd Cohort of Solve Ambassadors: Meet Paraspeak from India
Paraspeak is a cloud-based AI-powered feature that helps people with speech impairments communicate more clearly.

It improves unclear pronunciations into clearer speech in real time, supporting stroke survivors and individuals with neurological conditions in expressing themselves.

Paraspeak shows how innovation can begin with empathy and support meaningful connection.

Watch to see how this Top 10 Global Ambassador solution gives every voice its power back.

 #SolveAmbassador #SolveForTomorrow #TogetherForTomorrow #Samsung
